imputation_leakage_audit.impact_description: Original CP5 used CP2 imputed training set across all CV folds. CP5.1/CP5.2 fits imputer strictly fold-locally from raw training_data.csv.

model_identity_audit.resolution: Reconciled: Ridge(alpha=1.0) is the superior selected primary consistency estimator (OOF MAE=0.4945 vs GradientBoosting OOF MAE=0.7395). Both primary residuals and threshold evaluations strictly use Ridge(alpha=1.0).
